promotion_rules.B_over_A: B must meet every safety and retention threshold and improve first-pass acceptance over A by the frozen absolute threshold.
promotion_rules.C_over_B: C must meet every safety and retention threshold and improve first-pass acceptance over B by the frozen C-over-B delta.
promotion_rules.no_gain: Retain A when larger context produces no qualifying first-pass accepted-work gain.
promotion_rules.corrected_results: Corrected acceptance is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy promotion.
